previs_policy.evidence: Existing host policy. Eleven counts per 40 ms is the previous floored trajectory step (approximately 0.42 rad/s). cart_pace_max_m_s was raised from 0.35 to 0.50 on 2026-09-19 at the operator's request; it stays inside the unchanged UART command cap of 0.15, which the provisional linear map (command 0.04 to 0.1375 m/s) places at 0.515625 m/s, so a straight run at 0.50 transmits about 0.145. A turn needs the outer wheel faster than the centre pace and can still saturate the cap on a tight radius; the planner clips to the cap and reports achieved travel, not requested travel. These are not measured capabilities. Raising policy further requires commissioned wheel response and arm evidence; live_limits remain unverified.

commissioning_geometry_review: 2026-09-12: operator confirmed the displayed robot model is correct, the real light/bracket clears the platform, and explicitly requested execution of the saved simulator shot. Nominal geometry disagreements are recorded as advisories in supervised commissioning; qualified mode still requires clearance. This is operator review, not a measured clearance claim.
note: Host policies, not measured motor performance. io_limit_s bounds the complete read/write cycle as well as each call. Live limits require loaded evidence, including jerk. A live owner explicitly activates a captured fixed pose and retains torque until supported release; no automatic alignment, reconnect or fault release.
commissioning_limits_note: Command and tracking policy for supervised initial trials, not measured motor capability. Continuous derivative caps match the planner. Encoded finite differences allow only mathematically bounded one-count quantization error. Servos retain their onboard control settings.
